User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the proctoring system.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the user account was created.

suspicionScore.description: Current suspicion score for the user's active session.

status.description: Current proctoring status of the user.

examScore.description: The score achieved by the student in the last submitted exam.

examSubmitted.description: Whether the student has submitted their exam.

ExamSession.title: ExamSession
ExamSession.description: Represents a single exam session for a student.

id.description: Unique identifier for the exam session.

studentId.description: Reference to the Student taking the exam. (Relationship: Student 1:N ExamSession)

startTime.description: Timestamp of when the exam session started.

endTime.description: Timestamp of when the exam session ended.

suspicionScore.description: Overall suspicion score for the exam session.

examDetails.description: Stringified object of details about the exam session itself, such as the name, time, and questions

Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description: Represents an alert generated during an exam session.

examSessionId.description: Reference to the ExamSession this alert belongs to. (Relationship: ExamSession 1:N Alert)

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the alert was generated.

message.description: Description of the alert (e.g., 'Face not detected').

scoreImpact.description: The amount the suspicion score increased due to this alert.

ModuleStatus.title: ModuleStatus
ModuleStatus.description: Represents the status of different AI modules during an exam session.

id.description: Unique identifier for the module status.

examSessionId.description: Reference to the ExamSession this module status belongs to. (Relationship: ExamSession 1:N ModuleStatus)

faceDetection.description: Status of the face detection module (e.g., ACTIVE, INACTIVE, SIMULATED).

objectDetection.description: Status of the object detection module.

audioAnalysis.description: Status of the audio analysis module.

shadowDetection.description: Status of the shadow detection module.

StudyMaterial.title: StudyMaterial
StudyMaterial.description: Represents a single piece of study material, like a PDF or document.

title.description: The title of the study material.

description.description: A brief description of the material.

fileUrl.description: The public URL to the uploaded file in Firebase Storage.

fileName.description: The name of the uploaded file.

fileType.description: The MIME type of the file.

uploadedAt.description: Timestamp of when the material was uploaded.

PreviousYearQuestionPaper.title: PreviousYearQuestionPaper
PreviousYearQuestionPaper.description: Represents a single previous year question paper.

title.description: The title or year of the question paper.

description.description: A brief description of the paper (e.g., course name).

fileUrl.description: The public URL to the uploaded file in Firebase Storage.

fileName.description: The name of the uploaded file.

fileType.description: The MIME type of the file.

uploadedAt.description: Timestamp of when the paper was uploaded.

Assignment.title: Assignment
Assignment.description: Represents an assignment created by faculty.

description.description: A brief description of the assignment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the assignment was created.

Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: Represents a student's submission for an assignment.

studentId.description: Reference to the Student who submitted.

fileUrl.description: URL of the submitted file in Firebase Storage.

grade.description: The grade given by the faculty, out of 100.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile information. Path-based ownership ensures only the user or an admin can access the data.

/users/{userId}/examSessions/{examSessio.description: Stores exam session data for a student. Includes denormalized 'studentId' for authorization independence. Path-based ownership ensures only the user or an admin can access the data.
Stores alerts generated during an exam session. Path-based ownership ensures only the user or an admin can access the data.
Stores statuses of AI modules during an exam session. Path-based ownership ensures only the user or an admin can access the data.

/questions/{questionId}.description: Stores all exam questions. Admins can manage these, and students can read them during an exam.

/studyMaterials/{materialId}.description: Stores study materials. Admins/faculty can create and delete, while students can read.

/previousYearQuestionPapers/{paperId}.description: Stores previous year question papers. Admins/faculty can create and delete, while students can read.

/assignments/{assignmentId}.description: Stores assignments created by faculty. Admins/faculty can write, students can read.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores student submissions for assignments. Students create their own, faculty can read all and grade them.
